evidence.title: img2m3 – Shadcn UI Theme Generator from Any Image
img2m3 – Shadcn UI Theme Generator from Any Image

name: img2m3
summary: Shadcn UI theme generator that extracts a Material Design 3 color scheme from any image and outputs Tailwind CSS v4 code.
description: A studio that turns an uploaded image into a shadcn/ui theme: Material Design 3 algorithms extract an accessible color scheme and the tool generates Tailwind CSS v4 theme code. Free to use; the interface renders with JavaScript, so only the page title and meta description were readable.
